verdict.rationale: Muse documents its own ability to connect apps such as email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health data and finances, and says it can write custom connectors for services that have APIs or CLIs. Nothing in the evidence shows a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps and connectors to pick from. missing for 10: a browsable directory/catalog of third-party connectors, documentation of the add/install flow, the breadth of the available catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: Connect the apps you use daily, like email, calendar, and Instagram. You decide what your agent can see and what it can do.
Link your email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health and fitness data, and finances.
Muse can also write its own custom connectors for other services you care about if they have their own APIs or CLIs.
